{{Use dmy dates|date=August 2026}}
This is a '''list of player transfers involving [[Premiership Rugby]] teams''' before or during the [[2026–27 Premiership Rugby|2026–27 season]].

The list consists of deals that have been confirmed and are for players who are moving either from or to one of the 10 [[Rugby union in England|rugby union]] clubs which competed in the Premiership during the [[2025–26 Premiership Rugby|2025–26 season]].

It is not unknown for confirmed deals to be cancelled at a later date.<ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/rugby-union/2024/06/13/rugby-transfers-premiership-salary-cap-agents-overseas/ | title=Special report: How a rugby transfer really works | publisher=The Daily Telegraph | date=13 June 2024 | access-date=27 September 2024 | url-access=subscription}}</ref>
